# Karan Sud

> Growth and content marketer for brands and founders: 13+ brands and founders in 7+ industries. He builds content systems,
> KOL and community programs and launch campaigns, and he builds his own marketing software.

## Who he is
Karan Sud studied mechanical engineering and worked as a CFD engineer before moving into
marketing in June 2023. He works from Noida, India. He runs content, community and growth
for brands and founders: AI and crypto apps, restaurants, home brands, sports media and executives.
He builds software too: a free Account Research Engine and SlouchGuard, a posture app for Mac.

## Selected results (each with its public or screenshot source on the site)
- FanTV AI: X account from 70K to 297.7K followers in 11 months, with airdrops and a 100+ KOL program; Discord and Telegram past 150K members.
- Defx: helped the perpetuals DEX reach $1.5B in cumulative perp volume, public on DefiLlama; active traders from about 50 to about 350.
- Fere AI: 7K+ daily active traders and 12K+ signups with zero paid budget; #2 Product of the Day on Product Hunt (17 May 2026); 6.8M X impressions from 1 Sep 2025 to 27 Apr 2026.
- Novaswap: $800K+ organic trading volume in 3 months; 1.1M X impressions and 53.9K engagements on an account opened in November 2025.
- Prashan Agarwal (founder of FanTV): X from 12K to over 90K followers.
- Mohaimina Haque (CEO of Tony Roma's): 1.2M+ organic impressions in six months.
- Tony Roma's: 678.5K organic Facebook views from 1 Sep 2025 to 27 Apr 2026.
- The SportsRush: Instagram from 26 to 4,500 followers in three months, reels at 4M and 2M views, no ad spend.
- Potters' Hub: month one, ₹20,000 in revenue from ₹3,500 of Meta ads.
